name: Joachim Stanisław Brudziński - Proposition de décision
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2023, Section II – European Council and Council
part_text:
The European Parliament has postponed its decision on whether to approve how the Council spent its 2023 budget. Parliament says the Council has refused for over a decade to answer its questions or take part in hearings, so Parliament cannot properly check the spending. Parliament asks the Council to cooperate, to split the European Council and Council budgets, and to be more transparent about documents, lobbying and staff. It also calls for a change to the European Union treaties so Parliament can approve each institution's spending separately.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament postponed its approval decision and asks the Council to cooperate.
- **Who it affects:** The Council, the European Council and European taxpayers.
- **What happens next:** Parliament wants talks with the Council to end the deadlock.
